title.narrative: Midterm review of the Danish Strategic Partnerships 2022-2025

description.narrative:
Purpose The purpose of the midterm review is to assess the SPA 2022-2025 modality, which will be used to take stock of and inform the current phase of strategic partnerships, and further to suggest possible adjustments. The review will also inform the initial design of the next strategic partnership phase, starting from 2026, and may also inform other strategic processes relevant to Danish development assistance.
Objective The objective of the midterm review is to analyse the implementation, effectiveness and strategic relevance of the SPA 2022-2025 and the partners' adherence to, and performance of, the specific distinctions of the modality. The review will offer an assessment of the SPA 2022-2025, whether and how the requirements and guidelines are adhered to by partner organisations, including related implications and consequences. It will also assess whether elements might be adjusted or improved within the current phase. The review should be able to stimulate learning and provide background for further relevant SPA 2022-2025 developments and cross-cutting analysis. Finally, the review should include findings and recommendations for the MFA to follow up upon. The Consultant will perform the review in Denmark, as a desk-assignment combined with consultations/interviews with SPA 2022-2025 partner organisations as well as relevant MFA staff. This includes reviewing and assessing selected relevant material related to the SPA 2022-2025.
